excerpt: Figure 6 reports that Ansor is best or tied for best in all single-operator and batch-size settings and outperforms existing search frameworks by 1.1x to 22.5x. Figure 8 reports that Ansor outperforms manual libraries and other search frameworks by 1.1x to 14.2x on subgraph benchmarks across Intel CPU and NVIDIA GPU cases.
overview: These benchmark results are the main quantitative support for Ansor's operator-level and subgraph-level effectiveness. They connect the search-space design to measured throughput improvements and include comparisons against both search frameworks and vendor-backed libraries. The evidence is limited to the paper's selected operators, subgraphs, hardware, and tuning budgets.
title: Operator and Subgraph Speedups
